facts.fact: Orange Madagascar inaugurated on 1 December 2025 a 558 km fibre link from the capital Antananarivo to Mahajanga, which it calls a national backbone (2424.mg, quoting the operator).
Orange Madagascar's Antananarivo-Toamasina fibre link was put in place in 2024 (works launched August 2024), per 2424.mg.
